original_title: Ado 2nd LIVE: カムパネルラ
overview: This is Ado's first live video work, featuring all the songs from her legendary Saitama Super Arena concert held on August 11, 2022!  Included are 24 songs in total, including her smash hits "Usseewa," "Odori," and "Shinjidai," as well as her favorite Vocaloid songs "Darling Dance" and "Zaneri".
title: Ado 2nd LIVE: Campanella
